summary:
Iteration 18 - Leasing offer coffee-binding (product+price+minKg required), customer decline/question, admin overview of leasing coffee contracts. BACKEND: 15 passed / 1 skipped (pytest_iter18.xml). Verified: (a) PUT /api/machine-requests/{id} for LEASING with status='Angebot' returns 400 without minCoffeeKgMonth (missing OR <=0), 400 without productId, 400 without coffeePricePerKg (missing OR <=0); returns 200 when all three provided and terms carries productId+coffeePricePerKg+coffeeName (resolved from products.brand+name). (b) FINANZIERUNG offer accepts terms without any coffee fields (200). (c) POST /machine-requests/{id}/accept for a fully-provisioned LEASING offer auto-creates a contract with source='machine_leasing', productId=terms.productId, price=terms.coffeePricePerKg, minQtyMonth=terms.minCoffeeKgMonth. (d) POST /machine-requests/{id}/respond {action:'decline'} sets status='Abgelehnt'; {action:'question', message:...} sets status='Rückfrage' and appends to questions[]; a second question appends (>=2 entries); invalid action returns 400; a different customer (TEST_ user in another company) receives 403. (e) GET /api/machines/leasing-contracts returns 200 for admin AND sales, enriched with companyName+productName; customer receives 403; no ObjectId leak.

FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): (1) admin /maschinen-admin — LEASING request adm-req-<id> shows t-coffee-<id>, five t-prod-<id>-<pid> chips, t-cprice-<id>; FINANZIERUNG request has NONE of these coffee fields (verified: coffee=false, prods=0, cprice=false). Submitting send-offer-<id> without coffee fields did NOT change backend status (client-side Alert.alert on RN web doesn't route through window.alert, but state was preserved and no PUT succeeded). Filling all fields (rate=149.9, term=48, min=10, product Aiello Strong, cprice=22.5) + send-offer -> backend confirmed status='Angebot' with terms.productId=p2, coffeeName='Caffè Aiello Strong', coffeePricePerKg=22.5, minCoffeeKgMonth=10. (2) After customer posts a question, admin's adm-req card shows the 'Rückfragen des Kunden' box (styled uppercase 'RÜCKFRAGEN DES KUNDEN') listing the message '• Ist die Wartung inkludiert?'. (3) Bottom of /maschinen-admin lists Leasing-Kaffeeverträge section with lease-contract-<id> cards showing company (Ristorante Roma), machine, Leasingrate (89,00 €), Kaffee product, Kaffeepreis (21,00 €/kg), Mindestabnahme (7 kg/Monat), Laufzeit. (4) customer /maschinen — req-<id> for status='Angebot' shows Kaffeesorte + Kaffeepreis + Kaffee-Mindestabnahme in terms box, plus three buttons: accept-<id>, decline-<id>, question-<id>. Tapping question-<id> reveals question-input-<id> + question-send-<id>; sending flips status to 'Rückfrage' badge and hides the 3 action buttons. Tapping decline-<id> (with confirm dialog auto-accepted) flips status to 'Abgelehnt' visible after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: machines.py set_machine_terms: leasing validation only fires when status resolves to 'Angebot' (the default) — a staff saving a draft with a different status would bypass validation. Currently the only path from the admin UI sends status='Angebot' (default), so no practical issue, but consider always requiring the three fields for leasing regardless of status once the offer will eventually be sent.

machines.py respond_machine_offer: uses `_owns()` which returns True for admin/sales unconditionally. Staff can therefore submit a 'decline' or 'question' on behalf of the customer. This may be intentional (staff can log an internal Rückfrage) but if the requirement is strictly 'owner or staff', the spec is met. Message body accepts empty string for action='question' — consider requiring non-empty message when action=='question'.

machines.py accept_machine_offer: contract auto-creation only fires when r.customer.companyId is present; a customer without a company silently gets status='Bestätigt' but NO contract — verified in iteration 17. Consider surfacing this to admin as a warning.

maschinen-admin.tsx submit(): client-side validation uses Alert.alert. On RN web, Alert.alert falls back to window.alert but timing/behaviour is inconsistent (my Playwright dialog listener never fired). Consider a custom inline validation message (Text state) instead of Alert for a more reliable UX and testability.
Consistency: MachineTermsIn.status has no server-side allow-list; a staff could PUT status='Bestätigt' bypassing accept flow. Not exercised by current UI but a minor hardening opportunity.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed (15/15 passed, 1 skipped - alternate-customer login setup limitation, not a product bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin coffee fields for leasing / absent for finanzierung, Rückfragen box, Leasing-Kaffeeverträge section, customer accept/decline/question flow all verified)

seed_data_creation: Transient during this run: 5 machine_requests (M-2026-00040..00045) + 1 machine_leasing contract. All deleted in cleanup. Post-run DB: 3 demo machines preserved, 2 original seed contracts (S&S-2026-0187, S&S-2026-0142) preserved, 0 machine_leasing contracts, 0 machine_requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testIDs iteration 18: t-coffee-<reqId> (Mindestabnahme Input), t-prod-<reqId>-<productId> (Kaffeesorte chips), t-cprice-<reqId> (Kaffeepreis Input) - only in admin offer form for LEASING requests. decline-<reqId>, question-<reqId>, question-input-<reqId>, question-send-<reqId> in customer card. lease-contract-<contractId> in admin Leasing-Kaffeeverträge section. Rückfragen box is styled uppercase via CSS textTransform, so text-based grep for 'Rückfragen des Kunden' returns false while DOM text is stored in original case. GET /api/machines/leasing-contracts endpoint is admin+sales only. Backend contracts created via leasing accept now include productId + price (previously only machine/machineRate). To reproduce end-to-end: (1) customer creates leasing request, (2) admin PUT with productId + coffeePricePerKg + minCoffeeKgMonth, (3) customer accept -> contract.
